scripts.lint: npm run lint:modern && npm run lint:guards && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:generated && npm run lint:frontend

scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check

scripts.lint:fix:backend: python scripts/run_ruff.py check comicarr/ --fix && python scripts/run_ruff.py format comicarr/
scripts.lint:fix:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix frontend exec -- eslint . --fix
